name: @citolab/pci-coordinate-graph
description: the candidate draws points, sets of points, lines, segments, rays and solution sets of inequalities on a coordinate grid, scored with the author's correct elements
contributors: Thibault Milan, Open Assessment Technologies, for Parcc, Inc. (original PARCC graphLineAndPointInteraction, Graphing Line And Point)
Sam Sipasseuth, Open Assessment Technologies, for Parcc, Inc. (original PARCC graphLineAndPointInteraction and graphPointLineGraphInteraction, Point Graph)
Christophe Noël, Open Assessment Technologies, for Parcc, Inc. (original PARCC graphPointLineGraphInteraction, Point Graph)

scripts.prepack: npm run prod && npm run package-tao

response.$comment: Besides these, a field per element named by its id, as in PARCC graphLineAndPointInteraction: points_1, setPoints_2, lines_3, segments_4, rays_5: a list of point ([x, y]); solutionSet_6: a list of string, a polygon per shaded area ("x y, x y, …"). The PCI scores itself with the author's correct elements (data-elements); README
